question: During EAM Jaishankar's visit to Baku (23 Oct), India welcomed the Armenia–Azerbaijan peace agreement. Consider the following statements:
statements: India "welcomed" the Armenia–Azerbaijan peace agreement during the visit.
The International North–South Transport Corridor (INSTC) links India with Russia through Iran and Azerbaijan.
Azerbaijan was one of the three original signatories of the INSTC agreement in 2000.
tail: Which of the statements given above are correct?
explanation: India welcomed the peace agreement, and the INSTC runs India–Iran–Azerbaijan–Russia; but the 2000 agreement was signed by India, Iran and Russia only (Azerbaijan acceded later), so 3 is wrong.
subject: Current Affairs

question: Jio Platforms' IPO (21–23 Oct) became India's largest ever at about Rs 30,213 crore. Consider the following statements:
statements: The issue was largely an Offer for Sale (OFS) by existing shareholders such as Meta and Google.
About Rs 27,500 crore of the proceeds is earmarked to prepay borrowings of Reliance Jio Infocomm.
It surpassed Hyundai Motor India's 2024 IPO of about Rs 27,870 crore as the largest in India.
tail: Which of the statements given above are correct?
explanation: The issue was entirely a fresh issue (up to 27 crore shares) with no OFS, so 1 is wrong; Rs 27,500 crore goes to prepay Reliance Jio Infocomm's borrowings, and it overtook Hyundai Motor India's Rs 27,870 crore (2024).
subject: Current Affairs

question: The CISF moves from territorial to sector-based commands from 1 November 2026. Consider the following statements:
statements: The new structure includes a West Coast Port Sector (Mumbai) and an East Coast Port Sector (Chennai).
The CISF functions under the Ministry of Defence.
The CISF is the nodal force for seaport security as a Recognised Security Organisation under the ISPS Code.
tail: Which of the statements given above are correct?
explanation: Sector-based commands (incl. Mumbai and Chennai port sectors) start 1 Nov 2026 and the CISF is the ISPS-Code Recognised Security Organisation for seaports; the CISF is under the Ministry of Home Affairs, not Defence, so 2 is wrong.
subject: Current Affairs

question: The LAHDC (Amendment) Regulation, 2026 extends Hill Development Councils in Ladakh. Consider the following statements:
statements: Councils can now be constituted in all eight districts of the Union Territory, not only Leh and Kargil.
The Regulation extends the Sixth Schedule of the Constitution to Ladakh.
The Lok Sabha MP from Ladakh is an ex-officio member of every council.
tail: Which of the statements given above are correct?
explanation: Councils are now possible in all eight districts and the Ladakh MP is an ex-officio member; this is a statutory route, not a Sixth Schedule extension (which remains the core local demand), so 2 is wrong.
subject: Current Affairs

question: State Legislative Councils were in focus after elections to 28 seats (23 Oct) in Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Maharashtra and Karnataka. Which one of the following is NOT correct?

options.text: Six States currently have Legislative Councils: UP, Bihar, Maharashtra, Karnataka, Telangana and Andhra Pradesh.
Parliament can create or abolish a Council by ordinary law after the Assembly passes a special-majority resolution; this is not an Article 368 amendment.
One-third of the members of a Legislative Council retire every second year.
A Money Bill passed by the Assembly can be rejected outright by the Legislative Council.

explanation: A Council has no power to reject a Money Bill; it can only return it with recommendations within 14 days, and the Assembly may accept or reject them. Statements (a) to (c) are correct.
subject: Current Affairs

question: The Fund for responding to Loss and Damage (FRLD) held its first-ever extraordinary Board meeting on 22 October. Consider the following statements:
statements: The Fund was agreed at COP27 (Sharm el-Sheikh, 2022) and operationalised at COP28 (Dubai, 2023).
The Board set aside US$ 21.6 million, including oversight fees, for Nepal after the Bhotekoshi flood.
The World Bank is the interim trustee hosting the Fund.
tail: Which of the statements given above are correct?
explanation: All three are correct: FRLD agreed at COP27 and operationalised at COP28, US$ 21.6 m ($20 m for Nepal plus $1.6 m oversight fees) set aside on 22 Oct, and the World Bank is the interim trustee.
subject: Current Affairs

question: India hosted the 12th BRICS Parliamentary Forum in New Delhi (26–27 Oct). Consider the following statements:
statements: The Forum was chaired by the Lok Sabha Speaker.
Its resolutions are binding on the governments of BRICS member states.
Egypt, Ethiopia, Iran and the UAE are among the current BRICS members.
tail: Which of the statements given above are correct?
explanation: The Speaker chaired the Forum, and the listed members include Egypt, Ethiopia, Iran and the UAE; the Forum is a parliamentary-diplomacy platform that supports summit decisions and its resolutions are not binding, so 2 is wrong.
subject: Current Affairs

question: Protests turned violent in Pasighat over the proposed Siang Upper Multipurpose Project. Consider the following statements:
statements: The Siang is the course of the Yarlung Tsangpo/Brahmaputra in Arunachal Pradesh.
The proposed project, of about 11,200 MW, is being developed by NHPC.
The project is proposed on the Subansiri river.
tail: Which of the statements given above are correct?
explanation: The Siang is the Arunachal stretch of the Yarlung Tsangpo/Brahmaputra and the 11,200 MW project is NHPC's; it is on the Siang, not the Subansiri, so 3 is wrong. It is also seen as a counter to China's proposed Medog project.
subject: Current Affairs

question: Which one of the following correctly describes the Container Manufacturing Promotion Scheme approved by the Union Cabinet on 28 October 2026?

options.text: A five-year scheme of Rs 1,000 crore to set up a single container-manufacturing cluster.
A scheme to raise annual container-manufacturing capacity to about 75,000 TEUs by 2030.
A scheme of Rs 10,000 crore running up to FY 2039–40, aiming at about 7.5 lakh TEUs a year, with interest subvention among its components.
An export-promotion scheme that gives no support to domestic container production.

explanation: Rs 10,000 crore up to FY 2039–40, target of about 7.5 lakh TEUs a year (nearly tenfold), with 3% interest subvention, opex assistance and testing/certification support; the other options misstate outlay, capacity or purpose.
subject: Current Affairs

question: The Cabinet approved the Pradhan Mantri Viksit Gram Swaraj Yojana (PM-VGSY) on 28 October 2026. Consider the following statements:
statements: It is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme for 2026-27 to 2030-31, with an outlay of Rs 7,395.55 crore.
The outlay is shared between the Centre (about Rs 4,869 crore) and States (about Rs 2,526 crore).
The scheme is funded entirely by the Union Government.
tail: Which of the statements given above are correct?
explanation: A Centrally Sponsored Scheme for 2026-27 to 2030-31 of Rs 7,395.55 crore (Centre Rs 4,869.48 crore, States Rs 2,526.07 crore); being centrally sponsored, it is cost-shared, so 3 is wrong.
subject: Current Affairs

question: A young cheetah at Kuno died of suspected shotgun injuries and a poaching probe was ordered. Consider the following statements about the cheetah in India:
statements: The cheetah was declared extinct in India in 1952.
Project Cheetah began at Kuno on 17 September 2022 with cheetahs from Namibia.
Kuno National Park is located in Rajasthan.
tail: Which of the statements given above are correct?
explanation: The cheetah was declared extinct in India in 1952 and Project Cheetah began at Kuno on 17 Sept 2022 with Namibian cheetahs; Kuno is in Madhya Pradesh (Sheopur), not Rajasthan, so 3 is wrong.
subject: Current Affairs

question: India and Mexico signed Terms of Reference to launch negotiations on a Preferential Trade Agreement (PTA). Consider the following statements:
statements: A PTA covers only a negotiated list of tariff lines and is narrower than a Free Trade Agreement.
Mexico is a member of the USMCA.
The Terms of Reference conclude a full FTA covering goods, services and investment.
tail: Which of the statements given above are correct?

options.text:
1, 2 and 3

---

## Part B — Static Subject: International Relations · 8 MCQs

explanation: A PTA covers a negotiated list of tariff lines and is narrower than an FTA/CECA, and Mexico is in the USMCA; the Terms of Reference only launch PTA negotiations and do not conclude any agreement, so 3 is wrong. Part B — International Relations
subject: Current Affairs

question: Which one of the following is NOT one of the Five Principles of Peaceful Coexistence (Panchsheel) of 1954?

options.text: Non-interference in each other's internal affairs

explanation: Panchsheel (Agreement on Trade and Intercourse with Tibet, 29 April 1954) comprises mutual respect for sovereignty and territorial integrity, non-aggression, non-interference, equality and mutual benefit, and peaceful coexistence; non-alignment is a separate doctrine.
subject: International Relations

question: Consider the following statements:
statements: The Afro-Asian Conference of 1955 was held at Bandung, Indonesia.
The first Summit of the Non-Aligned Movement was held at Belgrade in 1961.
China's Zhou Enlai was one of the founding leaders of the Non-Aligned Movement.
tail: Which of the statements given above are correct?
explanation: Bandung (1955) and Belgrade (1961) are correct; the NAM's founding leaders were Nehru, Nasser, Tito, Sukarno and Nkrumah, and China was never a NAM member, so 3 is wrong.
subject: International Relations

question: The "Gujral Doctrine" in India's foreign policy is best described as:

options.text: Insistence on reciprocity for every concession made to a neighbouring country
A refusal to sign bilateral agreements without a third-party guarantor
A policy of not asking for reciprocity from smaller South Asian neighbours, and giving what India can in good faith
A commitment to support only democratic regimes in the neighbourhood

explanation: I.K. Gujral's doctrine (1996–97) rests on non-reciprocity towards smaller neighbours; it is among its five principles, which also stress non-interference and peaceful settlement of disputes.
subject: International Relations

question: Consider the following statements about the International North–South Transport Corridor (INSTC):
statements: The inter-governmental agreement was signed in 2000 by India, Iran and Russia.
Chabahar port lies on the Gulf of Oman in Iran's Sistan and Baluchestan province.
The corridor is designed to bypass Iran entirely by using the Suez Canal route.
tail: Which of the statements given above are correct?
explanation: INSTC was agreed by India, Iran and Russia in 2000 (St Petersburg) and Chabahar is on the Gulf of Oman; the corridor runs through Iran (Bandar Abbas/Chabahar), so 3 is wrong.
subject: International Relations

question: With reference to the groupings active in the debate on United Nations Security Council reform, consider the following statements:
statements: The G4 consists of Brazil, Germany, India and Japan.
The "Uniting for Consensus" group opposes the creation of new permanent seats.
The "Ezulwini Consensus" is the common position of Latin American States.
tail: Which of the statements given above are correct?
explanation: G4 is Brazil, Germany, India, Japan and Uniting for Consensus (led by Italy, Pakistan and others) opposes new permanent seats; the Ezulwini Consensus is the African Union's position, which seeks two permanent seats with veto for Africa.
subject: International Relations

question: Which one of the following pairs of India's "Look East" and "Act East" policies is correctly matched?

options.text: Look East: launched in the early 1990s under the Narasimha Rao government. Act East: announced in 2014 at the East Asia Summit in Myanmar
Look East: launched in 1978 under the Desai government. Act East: announced in 2005 by Manmohan Singh
Look East: launched in 1997 under the Gujral government. Act East: announced in 2010 by Manmohan Singh
Look East: launched in 2002 under the Vajpayee government. Act East: announced in 2019 by Modi

explanation: Look East dates to 1991–92 (P.V. Narasimha Rao); Act East was announced by Modi in November 2014 at the East Asia Summit in Nay Pyi Taw, Myanmar.
subject: International Relations

question: Consider the following statements about SAARC:
statements: Its first summit was held at Dhaka in 1985.
Its Secretariat is located in Kathmandu.
Myanmar is a full member of SAARC.
tail: Which of the statements given above are correct?
explanation: The first SAARC summit was in Dhaka (1985) and the Secretariat is in Kathmandu; Afghanistan joined in 2007 as the eighth member, and Myanmar is only an observer, so 3 is wrong.
subject: International Relations

question: Consider the following statements:
statements: The Shimla Agreement (July 1972) was signed by Indira Gandhi and Zulfikar Ali Bhutto, and committed both sides to settle differences bilaterally.
The Tashkent Declaration (1966) was signed by Lal Bahadur Shastri and Ayub Khan after Soviet mediation.
Under the Shimla Agreement, the Line of Control was declared the international boundary between India and Pakistan.
tail: Which of the statements given above are correct?
explanation: Both agreements are described correctly; under Shimla the 17 Dec 1971 ceasefire line became the Line of Control, which is not an international boundary, so 3 is wrong.
subject: International Relations
